Hawaii Packing List
Emma Johnson's Vacation Itinerary

Destination: Hawaii
Dates: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

============================================================
PACKING LIST BASED ON VACATION ACTIVITIES
============================================================

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES
   (Waikiki Beach, Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay, Kayaking at Kailua Beach)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Clothing:
  ☐ Swimwear (2-3 sets)
  ☐ Beach towel
  ☐ Rash guard / UV-protective swim shirt
  ☐ Sunglasses with UV protection
  ☐ Wide-brimmed beach hat / cap
  ☐ Light, breathable cover-ups

Toiletries & Sun Protection:
  ☐ Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
  ☐ After-sun lotion / aloe vera gel
  ☐ Lip balm with SPF
  ☐ Insect repellent (for mosquitoes and bugs)

Gear:
  ☐ Waterproof dry bag / waterproof pouch
  ☐ Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel) OR confirmation of rental
  ☐ Kayaking accessories (life jacket if needed)
  ☐ Camera + extra memory cards
  ☐ Waterproof phone pouch

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
2. HIKING
   (Diamond Head Trail)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Clothing:
  ☐ Hiking shoes / sturdy boots
  ☐ Moisture-wicking hiking pants & shorts
  ☐ Hiking shirt (lightweight, breathable)
  ☐ Light long-sleeve shirt (for sun protection)
  ☐ Rain jacket / lightweight poncho
  ☐ Hat with brim (sun protection)
  ☐ Socks (2-3 pairs)

Gear:
  ☐ Hiking backpack
  ☐ Refillable water bottle
  ☐ Trail snacks / energy bars
  ☐ Trail map or downloaded GPS guide
  ☐ First aid kit (band-aids, antiseptic wipes)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
3. CULTURAL & RELAXATION EXPERIENCES
   (Luau at Polynesian Cultural Center, Hotel Spa)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Clothing:
  ☐ Elegant casual outfit for Luau (traditional Hawaiian attire or leotard optional)
  ☐ Spa-ready casual clothes
  ☐ Comfortable lounge clothes
  ☐ Perfume / cologne

Toiletries:
  ☐ Extra moisturizer (humid climate)
  ☐ Hair products / styling items

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
4. GENERAL TRAVEL ITEMS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Documents:
  ☐ Passport
  ☐ Visa (if required)
  ☐ Flight tickets / boarding passes
  ☐ Hotel reservations / accommodation details
  ☐ Travel insurance documents
  ☐ Emergency contact list

Electronics:
  ☐ Smartphone + charger
  ☐ Power bank / portable charger
  ☐ Camera + extra batteries / memory cards
  ☐ Headphones / earbuds

Health & Safety:
  ☐ Prescription medications
  ☐ Over-the-counter medications (pain relievers, antihistamines, motion sickness pills)
  ☐ Basic first aid kit
  ☐ Hand sanitizer

Personal Items:
  ☐ Underwear & sleepwear (7-10 sets)
  ☐ Travel-sized toiletries (toothbrush, toothpaste, deodorant, shampoo, conditioner)
  ☐ Makeup / skincare
  ☐ Laundry detergent sheets (for quick clean-up)
  ☐ Packing cubes / organizer bags

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5. ROAD TRIP & SHOPPING
   (Road trip to North Shore, Shopping at Ala Moana Center)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Miscellaneous:
  ☐ Driver's license
  ☐ Road trip snacks / beverages
  ☐ Shopping bags
  ☐ Cash / credit cards
  ☐ Reusable shopping tote

============================================================
NOTES
============================================================
• Hawaii has a warm, humid climate — pack lightweight, breathable fabrics.
• Bring rain gear — tropical weather can be unpredictable.
• Sun protection is essential at all outdoor activities.
• Check weather forecast before departure and adjust packing as needed.
• Consider packing versatile clothing that can be mixed and matched.
